# @sharadox/form-web-library

> Forms: a phone field with country flags and calling codes (React), and on the server bot checks, rate limit and a contact action emailing via @sharadox/email-web-library.

- /contact-problem: contactProblems({ name, email, phone }) → ("name" | "reach" | "email" | "phone")[]: a name and a valid way to reply, same rules on page and server
- /choice-request: requestChoices(event, choices) and useChoiceRequests(event, onRequest): a button elsewhere on the page asks the form to tick choices
- /bot-field: <BotFields honeypotField? startedAtField? honeypotLabel? />: the hidden honeypot and fill-time fields isLikelyBot reads
- /contact-action: createContactAction({ to, company (sender name, unless senderName?; subject "<labels.contact> · Name (Company)", e.g. "Contacto · Ana (Café)"), senderAddress?, site (domain; the form's `page` field is shown only on it or a subdomain), logo?: () => Promise<{ content, contentType, filename }> (inline cid:logo at the top), design? EmailDesign { name, logo? {width,height}, wordmark?, color, onColor?, fonts?, signature? } (default plainDesign(company): black), languageNames?, acknowledgement?: { [locale]: { subject, eyebrow, heading(name), paragraphs, messageLabel } } (automatic reply to the visitor's email, in their language, reply-to = to; a failed reply never fails the send), choices?: { key: label | { [locale]: label } }, reach? = 'email' | 'email-or-phone', requireMessage? = true, minimumMessageLength? = 1, requireChoice? = false, fields?: { name: label | { [locale]: label } }, labels?: { [locale]: Partial<ContactLabels> } (over CONTACT_LABELS: ENGLISH_LABELS, PORTUGUESE_LABELS; the company's email is in the visitor's form language, English when unknown); textIn(text, locale), rateLimit? = 5/hour per address, dailyMaximum? = 50 emails/day from everyone (per server instance; caps email cost under a flood), readConfiguration?, createSender?, reportError? }) → (form, ip) => { status: idle|sent|invalid|rate-limited|failed }. Reply-to = visitor when they gave an email; bots get fake 'sent'. The email: email-web-library's one layout, black on white (logo top left; the brand color on eyebrow, headings, quote bar, button), every detail, the message, then Form (page), Language (name), Sent (UTC), IP.
- Form fields: name, email, phone (valid: + digits spaces ().- with ≥7 digits), company, message, extra fields, locale, started-at, page (location.href at sending), website (honeypot), need (checkboxes).
- /parse-contact: parseContact(form, { choices, choiceField='need', reach, requireMessage, minimumMessageLength, requireChoice, fields, now }) → value { name, email, phone, company, message, locale, choices, fields }
- /contact-check isEmail(text), isPhone(text) (browser-safe, same rules as the server); /bot-check isLikelyBot; /rate-limit createRateLimiter({ window, maximum }); /field readField(form, name, max)
- Env: EMAIL_SERVER_HOST/PORT/USERNAME/PASSWORD, EMAIL_SENDER_ADDRESS. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- phone-field (client, React): PhoneField({ name, locale, defaultCountry?="PT", labels?={country,search}, inputProps?, className?, inputClassName? }); flag+calling-code button opens searchable listbox (Intl.DisplayNames names, default country first, arrows/Enter/Escape, outside press closes); number box digits only (max 15), "+"/"00" paste picks country; hidden input `name` = "+<code> <digits>" or ""; CSS vars --phone-field-line/-accent/-surface/-popover/-radius/-gap; flags lazy-loaded from @sharadox/icon-web-library/flag
- calling-code: CALLING_CODES (ISO alpha-2 → digits, 245 countries, from libphonenumber metadata, Apache 2.0), MAIN_CALLING_COUNTRY (shared code → main country), type CallingCountry
- phone-number: readPhone(text, current) → { country, digits }; fullPhone(country, digits) → "+351 912345678" | ""
- Changes by version: CHANGELOG.md (in the package)
- /contact-acknowledgement: contactAcknowledgement(site url) → { en, pt } ContactAcknowledgement with the same words for every site (subject "We received your message" / "Recebemos a sua mensagem", eyebrow "Message received" / "Mensagem recebida", "Thank you, Name." / "Obrigado, Name.", reply within one working day, "Your message" / "A sua mensagem", button "Visit host" / "Visitar host" → site/en, site/pt)
